channel.title: Scotland from the Sky
channel.desc: Explore how aerial photography has revealed Scotland's hidden ancient past and uncovered buried secrets. From an Aberdeenshire field where the very concept of time emerged, through the ghostly outline of a lost ornamental garden to the discovery of hundreds of pizza ovens that once fed Rome's mighty legions, presenter James Crawford reveals how ancestors have written their story on Scotland's landscape.
